findings.title: The rack colours are not explained

location.description: The rack plan in the hero panel.

findings.viewer_experience: A visitor sees green, dashed white and one dark blue rack with no word on which means free, held or theirs.

current.value: Three rack states with no key.

findings.target: Each rack state is named where the plan is shown.
findings.fix_direction: Add a short key beside the plan.
findings.source: Nielsen, 10 Usability Heuristics (visibility of system status)

closed_when.check: Looking at the plan, each colour has a stated meaning.

findings.title: The fee line does not say what it covers

location.description: The line under the plan that reads Rack M4 and $95 paid.

findings.viewer_experience: A visitor does not know if the fee is for the year or the month.

current.value: One amount and the word paid.

findings.target: The amount names the period it covers.
findings.fix_direction: Name the period beside the amount.

closed_when.check: Looking at the line, the amount names its period.
